overview: The Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee discussed the narrowing of school project designs from 29 options to six. Architect Matt Rice detailed the specific categories for these remaining options, which range from code-mandated repairs to entirely new construction.

items.title: Narrowing of Design Options
items.summary: Chair Jenny Graham reported that the committee reduced the initial 29 project options to six finalists during a meeting on March 27.

items.title: Categorization of Project Designs
items.summary: Architect Matt Rice explained the project's four design categories: Category A covers baseline code repairs, B involves internal renovations of existing structures, C focuses on preserving large athletic facilities for funding reasons, and D represents full new construction.

items.title: Project Outlook and Community Priorities
items.summary: The committee and architects will continue investigating the six scenarios to determine community priorities, noting that no single preferred option has yet been selected.

subject: High School Building Project Design Option Narrowing
